save_model_hub: save a model instance to a local directory with optional config and push to the Huggingface Hub
load_model_hub: load a pretrained model from the Huggingface Hub or local directory with automatic config deserialization
push_model_hub: upload model checkpoint files to a Huggingface Hub repository with custom commit message and file filters
create_mixin_class: create a custom ML model class inheriting from ModelHubMixin with metadata tags and custom type encoders
create_pytorch_mixin: create a PyTorch model class inheriting from PyTorchModelHubMixin with automatic safetensor save and load
